title: Equipment Data Analysis System (EDAS)
description: Industrial equipment data monitoring and analysis system for KSPA Paper Mill. Digitizes and centralizes daily operational data from multiple machines with real-time analytics and planned AI/ML fault detection models.
longDescription: Developing an industrial equipment data monitoring and analysis system for KSPA Paper Mill. Digitizing and centralizing daily operational data collected from multiple machines to support maintenance and operational decision-making.
highlights: Developing an industrial equipment data monitoring and analysis system for KSPA Paper Mill.
Digitizing and centralizing daily operational data collected from multiple machines.
Implementing real-time monitoring and analytical features to support maintenance and operational decision-making.
Planning future integration of AI/ML models for predictive analysis and early fault detection.

title: HR Management System
description: Role-based Human Resource Management System built on Microservices Architecture for a real client. Supports Admin, HR Manager, and Employee roles with CV filtering, attendance tracking, and leave management.
longDescription: Developing a role-based Human Resource Management System as an academic group project for a real client. Features recruitment, attendance, leave management, CV filtering, and employee services.
highlights: Developing a role-based Human Resource Management System as an academic group project for a real client.
Supporting multiple user roles, including Admin, HR Manager, and Employee.
Implementing features for recruitment, attendance, leave management, and employee services.
Developing key functionalities such as CV filtering, leave applications, and attendance tracking.
Designed to streamline HR processes and improve overall operational efficiency.

title: University Canteen System
description: Full-stack web application for managing university canteen operations with automated build, integration, and deployment pipelines using modern DevOps tools like Docker, Terraform, Jenkins, and Webhooks.
longDescription: Developed a full-stack web application for managing university canteen operations, focusing on implementing modern DevOps practices throughout the project lifecycle.
highlights: Developed a full-stack web application for managing university canteen operations.
Primarily focused on implementing modern DevOps practices throughout the project.
Automated build, integration, and deployment processes using DevOps tools.
Applied CI/CD practices to streamline the software development lifecycle.

title: Real-Time Chat Application
description: Full-stack real-time messaging application with instant message delivery, WebSocket communication via Socket.IO, text messaging, and Cloudinary image sharing.
longDescription: Developed a full-stack real-time messaging application with instant message delivery and WebSocket communication using Socket.IO for dynamic updates without page refresh.
highlights: Developed a full-stack real-time messaging application with instant message delivery.
Implemented WebSocket communication using Socket.IO for dynamic updates without page refresh.
Supported text messaging and image sharing with Cloudinary integration.
Developed RESTful APIs for user interactions, message management, and data operations.
Ensured smooth and responsive real-time communication between users.
